replies.author: _DC
replies.body:
This is because the NoCheat (or NoCheat + or AntiCheat) plugin was taken out for Avicore so Ivy made his own plugin for preventing hacks. It will take a lot more refining I feel before it is perfect and I feel it could be. The best NoCheat plugin would never stop normal players and always stop hackers. But this is impossible to achieve 100% accuracy.

The problem is you have to have to balance it so it does enough testing for player location relative to blocks (So the player isn't flying) but not too much to cause server lag. I think this should stay and be refined a whole lot.
